title.narrative: Water, Sustainable Agriculture and Governance (WASAG) Project

description.narrative: The present rainfall variability has not only affected the farming patterns of the people but also affected drastically the underground water level and hence created more water shortages which sometimes cripple agricultural activities in some areas. In some cases, the unfavorable geographical condition on the Plateau with a focus on the project target Local Government Area (LGA) of Kanke adds to the problems of water shortages. With water as the core of sustainable socio-economic development, energy and food production, healthy ecosystems and human survival make it a rights issue. In line with Sustainable Development Goal 6 which is to “ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all,” water, therefore, becomes a necessity in communities. This project will ensure improvement in the quality of life and sustainable development among men, women, boys, and girls in Pankshin Diocese of Plateau State by 2023 by imploring the following approaches and strategies which have been designed based on the Project’s participatory approach to facilitate collaboration for sustainable development such as Awareness-raising and sensitization, advocacy, training, collaboration and networking, partnership, development and community participation.
